name: ProjectMind for Google Gemini CLI
description: Universal project memory, MCP server, Strict JSON lifecycle hooks, and GEMINI.md instructions for Gemini CLI.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Restart Gemini CLI or run `/hooks` and `/settings` to reload project hooks and MCP servers.
documentedLimitations: Gemini CLI fingerprints project hooks and prompts for user trust on first execution.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install gemini-cli` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update gemini-cli` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall gemini-cli` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
